name: Rankin County, MS
findings: Rankin County has 287 nonprofit organizations. 121 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 95 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rankin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Rankin County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 88 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
